description.short_caption: MRI of the lumbar spine showing abnormal enhancement and possible discitis or osteomyelitis.
description.detailed_description: This sagittal T2-weighted MRI image of the lumbar spine shows abnormal signal intensity and enhancement at the L4-L5 intervertebral disc space, suggesting discitis. Adjacent vertebral endplates appear irregular, consistent with possible osteomyelitis. There is also evidence of soft tissue involvement anterior to the spine. The image provides clear visualization of the vertebral bodies, intervertebral discs, and surrounding soft tissues.
visible_findings: abnormal signal intensity at L4-L5 disc space
irregular vertebral endplates at L4 and L5
soft tissue involvement anterior to the spine

Case_08012/figure2.jpg.source_caption: MRI of the lumbar spine, transverse cut.

description.short_caption: MRI of the lumbar spine, transverse cut showing abnormal signal intensity.
description.detailed_description: This is a transverse MRI image of the lumbar spine. The image shows a focal area of abnormal signal intensity at the level of the vertebral body and surrounding soft tissues, indicated by an arrow. The abnormality may suggest an infectious or inflammatory process, such as discitis or osteomyelitis. The surrounding soft tissue appears edematous, and there is evidence of contrast enhancement.
visible_findings: abnormal signal intensity in vertebral body

Case_08012/figure3.jpg.source_caption: Surgical pathology of the resected tissue.

description.short_caption: Histopathology of resected intestinal tissue showing mucosal architecture and parasitic structures.
description.detailed_description: This histopathology image shows a section of intestinal tissue stained with hematoxylin and eosin (H&E). The mucosal layer is visible with intact villous architecture (labeled A). Adjacent to the mucosa, parasitic structures (labeled B) are present, consistent with an infectious etiology. The parasites appear as oval or round structures with internal features, suggesting an invasive organism. The surrounding tissue shows mild inflammatory changes.
visible_findings: mild inflammatory changes in surrounding tissue
